items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: He goes out with Lenny Kravitz now.

ctx.x: Look at Elvis Costello, what he’s doing with this.

Yeah. With Allen Toussaint. You know you just can’t, on any given day it’s kind of like football, on any given day you can’t imagine what or where you may see a New Orleanean playing. Troy “Trombone” Andrews’ roots are in traditional jazz music. I mean he was playing the trombone on the streets of New Orleans in brass bands when he was eight years old, maybe even five, the trumpet was taller than he was. He goes out with Lenny Kravitz now.
